description: Day-1 goldens for PRS-002 generic surface. The legacy HITL-1 narrow path (RestartRecommendation) is covered by tests/test_auto_healer_lite.py, not here. These cases pin the eval-harness deterministic outcomes: REFUSED (validation failures) and BLOCKED (valid option, gate cleared the path through, default _no_approver rejected the REQUIRED action). The DRY_RUN_OK happy path requires a live approver and is exercised by tests/test_auto_healer_lite_prs002.py instead — eval-harness goldens stay deterministic.

cases.description: A well-formed RemediationOption (LOW blast set_flag from PRS-001) reaches the gate. The default _no_approver returns nobody → REQUIRED action blocks. Asserts the contract invariants stay True on a BLOCKED verdict.

option.title: Disable producer flag
option.rationale: From RCA: ranked #2 of 2 fix steps.

cases.description: The option does not declare requires_hitl=True. Auto-Healer refuses BEFORE consulting the gate so a buggy upstream never sneaks an unguarded action through. Catalog principle #3.
An option declares action_type=set_flag (non-manual) but carries no tool_capability. Malformed contract — Auto-Healer has no way to act on it. Refused.
Option carries no option_id. The audit trail can't cross-reference back to PRS-001 without one → refused before the gate.

Manual action — no tool_capability needed — still goes through the HITL gate. The gate blocks because the action is REQUIRED and there is no approver. Status=blocked, tool_capability=null is expected.

Higher-blast option (rollback_deploy, MEDIUM) carries its tool_capability cleanly. Same gate outcome — blocked because no approver is installed in the eval harness. Verifies the contract handles MEDIUM-blast actions identically.
